mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the lining and blood route was most worthwhile because it showed how the folds, thin lining and nearby capillaries work together to absorb food molecules.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the blood route was clear but fairly predictable: the capillaries simply joined the named vein.

surprise.text: The comparison showed how much surface can fit into the folds; the final cutaway also showed the molecules crossing without changing shape.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary. The goals and pictures made each pairing's purpose clear.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter: connecting the pieces helped me understand absorption, though the choices here were quite straightforward.
